p: fulfil: That is, how long they go with young?
bring forth their young ones: They bring forth with great difficulty.
barren land his dwellings: That is, the barren ground where no good fruit grows.

serve thee: Is it possible to make the unicorn tame? signifying that if man cannot rule a creature, that it is much more impossible that he should appoint the wisdom of God, by which he governs all the world.
warmeth them in dust: They write that the ostrich covers her eggs in the sand, and because the country is hot and the sun still keeps them warm, they are hatched.
in vain without fear: If he should take care of them.
wisdom: That is, to have a care and natural affection toward his young.
time she lifteth up herself on: When the young ostrich is grown up, he outruns the horse.
thunder: That is, given him courage? which is meant by neighing and shaking his neck.
paweth in the valley: He beats with his hoof.
swalloweth the ground with fierceness and: He so rides the ground that it seems nothing under him.
south: That is, when cold comes, to fly into the warm countries.
